content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the design of the pending TX buffer management, which used a custom single-linked list anchored at the buffer's slot on the TX ring. This design led to a situation where, if there was insufficient traffic on the ring, the system might never return to the slot to check for the completion of pending buffers. As a result, the application could be blocked from sending further traffic due to the unprocessed pending TX buffers. The patch addresses this by converting to a per-queue list_head, allowing the system to scan the list of pending buffers on every TX NAPI cycle, ensuring timely completion and freeing of buffers.
